description: Today, Oregon's 4th Congressional District candidate, retired Air Force Colonel Monique DeSpain, announced her unequivocal support and full endorsement of the effort to refer the state transportation tax and fee increases that secretly became law last Friday to the November 2026 ballot, so that voters can decide, while pointing out the silence of her opponent, incumbent Val Hoyle

title: While Val Hoyle Stays Silent - DeSpain Endorses Signature Gathering to Send State Transportation Taxes to the Ballot - Monique DeSpain for Congress
